content.text: {"window_id":"w0007","observed_failures":[{"id":"F1","description":"Candidate-voting across OCR variants selects wrong total when a high-priority keyword is corrupted in one variant (e.g., 078: 'Grand Total' line without number in 2/3 variants; sole surviving tier-0 candidate is garbage '20.00' from a line misread as 'O6SBRAISED ... 4350.00 20.00' or from an unrelated amount), overriding the correct tier-3 value 92.80 from the clean variant."},{"id":"F2","description":"Pure-priority-tier selection discards cross-variant agreement: for 074 two variants yield 702.00 at tier 3, one yields 102.00; majority vote picks 702.00 even though the correct value 102.00 is corroborated by Subtotal/Payment/Total-incl.-GST lines in the same receipt."},{"id":"F3","description":"OCR digit confusion on fine print (23.26 vs 23.25 for 077 after prior change) and generally for small or faded totals; no digit-confusion repair or cross-check with GST/subtotal arithmetic."},{"id":"F4","description":"Agent spent ~65 iterations hand-coding regexes, exclusion lists, summary-start heuristics and voting policies in extract.py; the Skill offered no concrete receipt-field recipe, so the work was reinvented from scratch and still hit max_iterations."}],"root_causes":[{"id":"R1","description":"image-ocr Skill (original) gave only generic Tesseract + multi-pass guidance; it had no concrete 'receipt total + ISO date' recipe, no priority-tiered keyword list, no exclusion list, no two-line fallback rule, no amount string-formatting rule, and no voting-across-variants guidance. Agent had to invent and debug all of this."},{"id":"R2","description":"No guidance on how to combine evidence across OCR variants: when to trust highest-priority keyword vs. cross-line/cross-variant agreement, and how to defend against a corrupted high-priority line hijacking the result (F1, F2)."},{"id":"R3","description":"No guidance on receipt-specific sanity checks: using Subtotal + Tax ≈ Total, or Payment/Change arithmetic (Cash - Change = Total), to validate or correct an extracted total; no mention of common OCR digit confusions (0/O, 1/l/I, 5/S, 7/1, 2/Z, 6/G, 8/B) for numeric fields."},{"id":"R4","description":"xlsx Skill emphasizes formulas and financial-model formatting, which is irrelevant and distracting for a 3-column data dump; it does not state the rule that string-typed numeric columns (like a 2-decimal 'total_amount') must be written as object dtype so pandas does not coerce '47.70' to float 47.7. Agent happened to get this right but Skill does not teach it."},{"id":"R5","description":"No Skill-level reminder that per-image failures must become null cells (not exceptions, not NaN text), that filenames must be sorted lexicographically, and that only files matching image extensions should be processed. These were handled ad hoc."}],"skill_defects":[{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"Missing a reusable 'structured receipt extraction' section: priority-tiered keyword list, exclusion list (including Cash Tendered/Received/Payment, Subtotal, Tax/GST/SST, Discount, Change), two-line fallback restricted to pure-keyword lines, number normalization (strip RM/$, strip commas, format with exactly two decimals as string or None), and ISO date reformatting with DD/MM/YYYY-first disambiguation for Malaysian-style receipts."},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"No guidance on multi-variant OCR evidence fusion: (a) collect candidates per variant with (tier, value); (b) prefer highest-priority tier that has any support; (c) within tier, prefer the value with highest cross-variant count AND cross-line corroboration (same value also appears as Subtotal/Payment/Total-incl.-GST); (d) when a high-priority candidate has only one supporting variant and conflicts with a lower-tier value that has multi-line/multi-variant support, prefer the corroborated value."},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"No guidance on arithmetic sanity checks for receipts: Subtotal + Tax ≈ Total, Cash - Change ≈ Total, Rounded Total ≈ Total; use these to reject OCR-corrupted candidates (e.g., 702 vs 102 when Subtotal=96.23 and Cash=102.00)."},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"No preprocessing-selection guidance keyed to receipts: grayscale + autocontrast, 2× upscale when max side <1500 px, PSM 6 as default plus PSM 4/11 as fallbacks, and a rule to try an inverted variant for dark-background receipts."},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"No explicit rule that per-image exceptions must degrade to (date=None, total=None) rather than aborting the batch, and no rule on filename filtering (image extensions only) and lexicographic sort order."},{"skill":"xlsx","defect":"No section on 'tabular data export with string-typed numeric columns': does not warn that pandas will coerce '47.70' to 47.7 unless the column is forced to object dtype, nor that None must be used for empty cells (not '' or 'NaN'). Also does not mention that for pure data dumps (no formulas) the formula/color-coding sections are inapplicable and should be skipped."},{"skill":"xlsx","defect":"No guidance for writing a single-sheet workbook with an exact sheet name and no extra sheets/columns — a common requirement for benchmark-style outputs; agent had to infer it."},{"skill":"openai-vision/pdf/video-frame-extraction","defect":"Not relevant to this task; no defect uncovered here, but their presence in context may distract. Consider a one-line 'when NOT to use' pointer in image-ocr steering agents away from these for pure Tesseract OCR tasks."}],"repair_recommendations":[{"target":"image-ocr/SKILL.md","change":"Add a new section 'Structured receipt extraction (date + total)' with: (a) priority tiers exactly as specified by typical tasks (GRAND TOTAL > TOTAL RM / TOTAL: RM > TOTAL AMOUNT > TOTAL/AMOUNT/TOTAL DUE/AMOUNT DUE/BALANCE DUE/NETT TOTAL/NET TOTAL); (b) exclusion list including SUBTOTAL/SUB TOTAL, TAX/GST/SST, DISCOUNT, CHANGE, CASH TENDERED/RECEIVED/PAYMENT, plus 'TOTAL <GST|TAX|SST>' and lines starting with GST/TAX/SST; (c) number regex that accepts 1,234.56 and 1234.56, strips RM/$ and commas; (d) rule: amount output is always a string with exactly two decimals or None; (e) two-line fallback only when the matched keyword line has no digits at all; (f) ISO date rule: try YYYY-[M]M-[D]D first, then DD[/-]MM[/-]YYYY, then DD <MonName> YYYY, reject years outside 1990–2100."},{"target":"image-ocr/SKILL.md","change":"Add 'Multi-variant evidence fusion' subsection: run OCR with multiple PSMs and preprocessing variants, collect ALL (tier, value) candidates per variant via the keyword rules above, then pick by: (1) best tier with any support; (2) within tier, highest cross-variant count; (3) tiebreak by cross-line corroboration — value also appearing on Subtotal/Payment/Total-incl.-GST lines in the same variant; (4) if the best-tier value has support in only one variant AND conflicts with a lower-tier value that is corroborated by ≥2 non-excluded lines or ≥2 variants, prefer the corroborated value."},{"target":"image-ocr/SKILL.md","change":"Add 'Arithmetic sanity checks' subsection: after choosing a candidate total T, if the receipt also exposes Subtotal S and Tax X with |S+X−T|<0.05, mark T as corroborated; if Cash C and Change K are present with |C−K−T|<0.05, mark T as corroborated. If no candidate is corroborated and multiple candidates differ, prefer the candidate whose digits require the fewest OCR confusion swaps (0↔O, 1↔l↔I↔7, 2↔Z, 5↔S, 6↔G, 8↔B) to match an arithmetically-consistent value."},{"target":"image-ocr/SKILL.md","change":"Add 'Batch-to-table contract' subsection: iterate directory sorted lexicographically; filter by extension {.jpg,.jpeg,.png,.webp}; wrap each image in try/except so a failure yields a row with date=None and total_amount=None rather than aborting; never emit empty string or 'NaN' as a value."},{"target":"image-ocr/SKILL.md","change":"Add 'Preprocessing presets for receipts': grayscale, autocontrast, optional 2× LANCZOS upscale when max(width,height)<1500, optional sharpen, optional inversion for dark receipts; recommend PSM 6 as default and PSM 4/11 as fallbacks; cite that running 2–3 variants is typically sufficient."},{"target":"xlsx/SKILL.md","change":"Add a short 'Pure data export (no formulas)' section: when writing tabular output with a numeric-looking string column (e.g., '47.70'), set that column's dtype to object before writing and use None for missing values; verify no implicit float coercion by reading the file back with dtype=str. Clarify that formula/color-coding standards do not apply to such plain data dumps."},{"target":"xlsx/SKILL.md","change":"Add a short 'Single-sheet exact-schema output' note: when a task specifies exact sheet name, column order, and no extra sheets/rows, create a fresh Workbook with a single explicitly named sheet (or use pandas ExcelWriter with sheet_name=...), do not rely on default 'Sheet' names, and remove any pre-existing default sheet."},{"target":"image-ocr/SKILL.md","change":"Add a 'When NOT to use other Skills' note: for Tesseract-based receipt OCR tasks, do not escalate to openai-vision; pdf and video-frame-extraction Skills are irrelevant and should not be invoked."}],"confidence":0.72}
